svg.title: On a map, the Gulf ports from Corpus Christi to the Mississippi form the largest cluster of large-ship port visits

cc:Work.dc:title: On a map, the Gulf ports from Corpus Christi to the Mississippi form the largest cluster of large-ship port visits
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the lower 48 states with one non-overlapping circle per deep-draft port, sized by large-ship port visits and colored by coast; the largest circles crowd the Texas and Louisiana coast.
